scope: Scrape tab source controls, nested flows, errors, identity and reload states

source_mapping.behavior: Header identity retry, stale-capture warning, highlight handoff, Source recognition/lookup messages, diagnose launch and result, and error recovery are rendered adjacent to the main capture controls. Fast/deep capture use the guarded recapture flow; current capture state gates Save and result access. Each behavior maps to an existing control and case.

Capture header/export, not-yet-a-Source and recognized-Source banners, six result tabs, article edit/apply/cancel and scroll sync, per-section copy menus, media/link row actions, empty state, Save form entry, save-success actions, inline rename retry, File elsewhere, and unsaved-edits confirmation all have existing control/case mappings.

Image size tiers expose open/copy/remove affordances as applicable; AddItemRow controls expose draft inputs, Add validation, and Cancel for image, video and link rows. No additional control is missing from inventory.

Capture error card renders Dismiss and offered Reload page/Try again actions. Diagnostics disclosure is conditionally rendered for admin only; the existing case includes guest/member negative visibility checks.
Missing/Unwanted mode selection, picker launch, diagnosis note, expandable selectors/HTML, copy variants, dismissal, picker launch failure with Retry picker/Dismiss are registered.

Native Save Source dialog exposes name and URL, close/Escape, optional place type and search-all controls, staged destination removal, optional Library including No Library, create-place flow and Save Source submission. The existing cases cover destination choices, cancellation, create, and role-specific behavior.
File elsewhere exposes existing Source destination selection, optional Library, and close. This is already covered as part of destination filing.

Device-local refused captures display their reason and expose Retry save and confirmed Discard. Retry preserves the item on refusal and informs Scrape on landing; the URL ownership rule suppresses duplicate Save.

covered_procedures: Guest fast/deep capture, busy state, six tabs, navigation stale-state and restricted-page dismissal
Save Source and unsaved capture retry/discard/reload, destination and Library selection, recognized Source and organization behavior
Diagnose Missing/Unwanted picker, copy actions, picker launch refusal and document transition
Inline SVG figure preservation, caption/HTML-label order and unavailable fallbacks

gaps.missing_procedure: A single explicit manual procedure for Article edit/apply/cancel and live-page scroll sync, per-pane copy menus, image open/remove/add, and video and link open/copy/remove/add.
gaps.evidence: These controls are registered in inventory.json with procedures, but the Scrape-focused feature-test sections do not provide a corresponding human walkthrough.

gaps.missing_procedure: An explicit guest/member/admin walkthrough for capture error actions and the admin-only Diagnostics disclosure's negative visibility in guest/member modes.
gaps.evidence: Feature-tests mentions restricted-page Dismiss and some picker/save recovery, while the full recoverable/nonrecoverable action set and role visibility check are only in the inventory procedures.

inventory_decision: No new controls, entry points, or cases found. The source control census maps to existing EXT-F-1007 controls/cases. The documented procedure gaps above affect human walkthrough completeness only; no inventory status or product verdict is inferred.
